name: Peor
overview: The Scripture passage in Numbers 23 highlights Peor as a significant location where Balak brought Balaam to the mountain's summit, overlooking Jeshimon. At Balaam's instruction, Balak built seven altars on Peor and offered sacrifices of bullocks and rams upon each. This event emphasizes Peor as a site of ritual worship and divine interaction during Israel's wilderness journey.
